hero.intro: Here you can look around and read about the work I've made. As a frontend developer, I live and breathe for UX/UI and user experience. I made it my mission to make navigating platforms as effortless and intuitive as possible for the user.

home.aboutText: Frontend Developer specializing in UX/UI. Dedicated to crafting seamless digital interfaces where functionality meets flawless design. My goal is simple: making the complex feel effortless.
home.contactPitch: Turns out you're missing someone like me on your team — so don't hesitate to reach out.

portfolio.description: A collection of projects where I've combined design and code.

conversion.title: Conversion — Real-Time Marketing Dashboard
conversion.description: A live overview for marketing teams that tracks traffic and conversions in real time, compares campaign performance across channels, and catches invalid traffic and VPN proxies before they skew the numbers.
conversion.considerations: Since the whole point is watching numbers move in real time, I kept the layout calm and glanceable — clear stat cards and charts up top, with campaign and conversion detail just one click away instead of competing for attention on the same screen.

moneta.title: Moneta — Financial Dashboard
moneta.description: A financial dashboard for contractors that tracks bills, invoices, and cash flow across active jobs — built to surface what needs sign-off or follow-up at a glance.
moneta.considerations: The biggest challenge was fitting a lot of numbers on screen without overwhelming the user, so I leaned on progress rings and charts over tables wherever a trend mattered more than an exact figure.

ghost.title: Ghost — AI Assistant / LLM
ghost.description: An LLM-powered assistant that understands natural language requests and gives users instant answers, support, and automated task handling without digging through menus.
ghost.considerations: I focused on designing clear loading and typing states so the wait for an AI response never feels like the interface has stalled.

mediadeck.title: MediaDeck — Streaming Services Overview
mediadeck.description: A dashboard that gathers your subscriptions, watch history, and spending across streaming services in one overview, so you can see at a glance what you're actually using.
mediadeck.considerations: The hardest part was making subscriptions you rarely think about feel worth checking in on, so I leaned on simple monthly-cost and usage comparisons rather than raw historical data.

spine.title: Spine — Book Store (Print, Audio & E-books)
spine.description: An online bookstore where customers can browse and buy physical books, audiobooks, and e-books from a single shelf, with format-specific previews and checkout flows for each type.
spine.considerations: Physical, audio, and digital books each need a different kind of product page — a sample chapter, an audio preview, a shipping estimate — so I planned the layout to adapt per format instead of forcing everything into one generic template.

dayframe.title: Dayframe — Personal Dashboard
dayframe.description: A personal command center for tracking daily habits, goals, and schedule in one place, pulling together the small metrics that are easy to lose track of individually.
dayframe.considerations: Since it's a dashboard for one person rather than a team, I prioritized quick daily glances and light personalization over dense reporting.
